Module info5.sar
Package info5.sar.EventBasedMessageQueue.Impl

Class QueueBroker

java.lang.Object
info5.sar.EventBasedMessageQueue.Impl.QueueBroker
All Implemented Interfaces:
IQueueBroker
public class QueueBroker extends Object implements IQueueBroker
QueueBroker is an implementation of the IQueueBroker interface that wraps an internal Broker instance to provide message queue-specific binding and connection management. This class extends the functionality of the base Broker class to manage event-based message queuing, making it easier to bind listeners and handle connections.

It provides methods to bind, unbind, and connect to ports, delegating these operations to the internal Broker instance while adapting listeners to handle message queuing events.

Constructor:

  • QueueBroker(String): Initializes the QueueBroker with a specific name, creating an internal Broker instance.

Methods:

  • name(): Returns the name of the internal broker.
  • unbind(int): Unbinds a specified port, stopping any listening activity on that port.
  • bind(int, IAcceptListener): Binds a specified port to an IAcceptListener adapted for message queuing, enabling connection acceptance on that port.
  • connect(String, int, IConnectListener): Connects to a remote broker by name and port, delegating to an IConnectListener adapted for queuing events.
